1.explanation:
1. ListBoxSelection.js defines the clear-selection button and renders the Close16 SVG. The inner `<svg>` has role="img" but no <title> or aria-label, so it fails the nonempty alternate text rule.

2. ListBoxMenu.js renders the menu container (`<div role="listbox">`) but does not apply a fieldset or ARIA grouping around its checkbox children. Without a grouping container or role="group", browsers and screen readers cannot identify that the checkboxes belong together.

3. MultiSelect.js is responsible for rendering the list of native checkboxes inside the downshift menu. Because it uses `<Checkbox>` inputs rather than ARIA listbox options, it must explicitly add grouping (e.g., wrap inputs in a fieldset or role="group") and ensure its interactive elements have proper accessible names, but it currently does neither.
1.bug_scenario:
The screenshots show a Carbon React MultiSelect initialized with two selected items. In the closed state, the control renders a pill-style clear button (“2 ×”) whose inner SVG (Close16) has role="img" but no title or accessible name, triggering the DAP error “The WAI-ARIA widget with IMG role must have a nonempty alternate text or a label.”

When the menu is expanded, each option is rendered as a native `<input type="checkbox">` inside the listbox, but those checkboxes (all sharing the same label values like “Option 1”, “Option 2”, etc.) are not wrapped in a fieldset or grouped with an ARIA role="group", causing the DAP violations “Use grouping roles or elements to identify related form controls.”
